common_window.chosen_by: the rectangle maximising countries x semesters, computed rather than picked

config.independent_loops: b1 = 4 - 4 + 1 = 1 per country; the independent count is the number of countries, not the number of cells

state_to_verdict.exactly_zero: the rival is right in that cell

B52-1.detail: 33 countries, 38 semesters, 1076 cells, 33 independent loops (one per country, not one per cell); 2 cells dropped for a zero or negative price: AL 2021-S2, AL 2022-S1
B52-1.name: panel completeness, printed country by country

B52-2.detail: floor 1.579e-03 over 1076 comparisons in EUR, worst at GE 2019-S2
B52-2.name: the square does not move with the currency the prices are quoted in (implementation check, not independent confirmation); only a pure exchange-rate conversion sets the floor

B52-3.detail: 0 of 1069 readable cells are exactly zero; 7 cells unreadable and not judged
B52-3.name: no readable cell matches the rival's point prediction of exactly zero; cells at or below the floor carry no verdict because the instrument cannot separate zero from non-zero there

B52-4.detail: 1069 of 1076 above 1.579e-03; smallest 0.1x, median 103x; at or below: AT 2009-S2, AT 2016-S1, DE 2025-S1, DK 2019-S1, HU 2023-S2, LV 2008-S2, SK 2012-S1
B52-4.name: every cell at or below the floor is named and carries no verdict. A continuous quantity read at a thousand points will pass near zero somewhere, so the count of such cells is a reading and not a failure; what can fail is leaving them unnamed

state_map.exactly_zero: the rival is right in that cell

B52-5.detail: 33 countries read, + to - is 6 (BA, DE, FR, HR, LT, TR), - to + is 5 (BE, CZ, ES, LI, PL), unchanged 22
B52-5.name: the sign drift is one-directional, in the shape B49 read it: one of the two directions is empty. Comparing the two counts with a strict inequality would be a zero-width test on integers, so what is asked is whether the smaller direction is zero. Each country is read over its own first and last semester, and those windows are not the same window, which B52-6 asks again on one that is

B52-6.detail: 2008-S1..2025-S2, 22 countries x 36 semesters; + to - is 5 (DE, FR, HR, HU, TR), - to + is 2 (CZ, ES), unchanged 15
B52-6.name: the same one-directional question on a window every country shares for its whole length, so that a fixed comparison rule is not applied over heterogeneous windows

B52-7.detail: 2008-S1..2021-S1 over 23 countries: + to - is 3 (DE, FR, HU), - to + is 2 (LT, SI), unchanged 18; by direction of change rather than sign, 14 down and 9 up before the crisis against 15 down and 7 up over the full window
B52-7.name: B49 read a moving sign. If that has a basis independent of the 2021-2023 energy interventions, part of it is already present in a window stopping before them. The cut date is fixed, not searched

currency_identity.note: implementation check, not an independent confirmation
currency_identity.vacuous_note: a euro-area country quotes in euro already, so the conversion is the identity and the comparison carries nothing there

panel.dropped_note: a zero is an absence, not a price: it cannot be logged and the cell leaves the panel. This is a different state from a reading below the floor.

pre_crisis_window.cut_note: fixed at the last semester before wholesale gas moved, not searched over
